༄༅/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i thugs sras spyan snga shes rab 'byung gnas kyi gsung 'bum dkar chag bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang ratna shrī'i thugs sras spyan snga shes rab 'byung gnas kyi gsung 'bum dkar chag bzhugs so//

01) 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa rdo rje rin po che 'bar ba/ 02) 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa phyogs bcu dus gsum ma/ 03) 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam thar phyogs bcu dus gsum ma'i 'grel pa/ 04) 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa rma bya seng ge ma/ 05) 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa mthong ba don yod ma/ 06) 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i rnam par thar pa zad mi shes pa'i za ma tog bkod pa/ 07) 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i bstod pa byang chub rdul bral ma/ 08) brgyud 'debs byin rlabs sprin phung*/ 09) dpal phag mo gru pa'i gdung rten bkra shis sgo mang gi dkar chag bsdus pa/ 10) 'jig rten gsum gyi mgon po'i gdung rten bkra shis sgo mang gi dkar chag dang lo rgyus/ 11) byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa'i cho ga bsil byed tsan dan gyi phreng ba/ 12) dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i rtsa tshig rdo rje'i gsung brgya lnga bcu pa'i bsdus don/ 13) dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i 'dul ba'i tshoms gsal byed sgron me/ 14) dam chos dgongs pa gcig pa'i sa bcad/ 15) spyan snga 'bri gung gling pa'i gsung thor bu 'ga' zhig phyogs gcig tu bkod pa/
